headline_outcome: Own It. End the Cycle for Good.
primary_text: "Our lease is up in 12 months and the landlord wants a 30% increase or we're out." Hundreds of Melbourne west businesses have been in your shoes — backed into a corner by a landlord who knows the market is tight. Many of them now own their own warehouse in Truganina and will never face a lease negotiation again. Purpose-built off-the-plan warehouses for owner-occupiers. Near Princes Freeway, West Gate Tunnel, and Port of Melbourne. See how other small businesses broke free from the lease cycle. Your premises, your rules.
description: Join hundreds of businesses that escaped the lease cycle by owning in Truganina
